summary: Frontend-only testing of expanded Curricular Areas modal with collapsible accordion (AreaSubjectsManager) and link sub-modal. All 13 critical UI/UX requirements verified at https://area-subject-link.preview.emergentagent.com/areas-curriculares using admin@elroble.edu. Lazy-load, debounce search, bulk selection, reassign warning, and empty state all work as specified.

verified_behaviors.login: OK with admin@elroble.edu / 1234abc8 (inputs lack name attribute but placeholder-based fill works)
verified_behaviors.main_table: 10 areas loaded with subject counters (Comunicación=8, Matemática=17, Inglés=0, EPT=0, etc.)
verified_behaviors.modal_open_comunicacion: Edit modal shows fields Nombre/Orden/Color/Activa + accordion 'Asignaturas vinculadas (8)' CLOSED by default (testid present)
verified_behaviors.lazy_load_confirmed: Before clicking accordion: 0 calls to /api/curricular-areas/{id}/subjects. After clicking: 1 call -> /api/curricular-areas/{id}/subjects?page=1&page_size=20. Panel element absent before opening.
verified_behaviors.linked_table: Renders 8 rows with Nombre/Código/Grado-Sección/Profesor/Acción columns and per-row data-testid=area-subject-row-{id}
verified_behaviors.search_debounce: Typing 'leng' -> table filtered to 7 rows with exactly 1 API call (300ms debounce honored)
verified_behaviors.select_all_and_bulk: select-all-checkbox + per-row subject-checkbox-{id} work. bulk-unlink-btn initially disabled (true), becomes enabled with text 'Desvincular seleccionadas (1)' after selecting one row
verified_behaviors.unlink_confirm_dialog: unlink-confirm-modal testid present in markup; confirm-unlink-btn renders. (Not destructively executed to preserve seed.)
verified_behaviors.submodal_open: open-link-submodal-btn opens link-submodal with header 'Vincular asignaturas a Comunicación', search input, and toggle. Initial fetch to /available-subjects?unassigned_only=true
verified_behaviors.unassigned_only_default_on: Toggle is checked=true by default. Only 1 available row when ON (matches unassigned subjects).
verified_behaviors.toggle_off_shows_other_areas: Switching OFF triggers /available-subjects?unassigned_only=false; table refreshes to 20 rows with amber badges showing current area (Matemática, Ciencia y Tecnología, etc.)
verified_behaviors.reassign_warning: Clicking row with badge shows reassign-warning banner: '1 asignatura será reasignada a Comunicación: Algebra (actualmente en Matemática)'
verified_behaviors.empty_state_ingles: Opening Inglés (0 subjects) accordion renders area-subjects-empty with Inbox icon + 'No hay asignaturas vinculadas a esta área. Haz clic en "Vincular asignaturas" para empezar.'
verified_behaviors.submodal_close_preserves_state: Closing sub-modal via X (link-submodal-close) returns to main edit modal cleanly

critical_code_review_comments: Minor inefficiency: LinkSubjectsSubModal triggers 2-3 calls to /available-subjects on initial open because both useEffect([page,unassignedOnly]) and useEffect([search]) fire on mount. Consider gating the search debounce effect to skip the first render. Not blocking.

Login inputs (email/password) lack name/id/data-testid attributes — only placeholders distinguish them. Consider adding data-testid='login-email-input' / 'login-password-input' / 'login-submit-btn' for robustness across the app.

Main areas table row edit pencil buttons rely on title/aria-label='Editar' for identification (no data-testid). Adding data-testid='edit-area-btn-{id}' on AdminCurricularAreasPage would simplify automation.
AreaSubjectsManager.jsx is 536 lines and contains two large components — consider splitting LinkSubjectsSubModal into its own file for maintainability.
In handleConfirm() the no-op toast condition `linked < selected.size && reassigned.length + newOnly === linked && linked < selected.size` has a duplicated comparison; clean up the logic.
seed_data_creation: None. No destructive link/unlink actions performed to preserve seed counters.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 frontend (AreaSubjectsManager accordion + LinkSubjectsSubModal) is fully functional. All data-testids documented in /app/frontend/src/components/curricular/AreaSubjectsManager.jsx are present and work. Login form inputs have no name/id; use placeholder ('tu@email.com o tu_usuario' and 'Tu contrasena') or index-based selectors. Destructive toast variants (single/2-3/4+/mixed-reassign) were not actually executed to preserve seed data — main agent or next iteration may want to validate the toast strings end-to-end on a non-prod area.
rca of the issue: No bug — feature implementation is correct per spec.
